modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On February 9, 1978: The Budd Company unveils its first SPV-2000 self-propelled railcar in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
On February 9, 1971: Satchel Paige becomes the first Negro league player to be voted into the USA's Baseball Hall of Fame.
On February 9, 1961: The Beatles at the Cavern Club: Lunchtime – The Beatles perform under this name at The Cavern Club for the first time following their return to Liverpool from Hamburg.
On February 9, 1959: The R-7 Semyorka, the first intercontinental ballistic missile, becomes operational at Plesetsk, USSR.
February 9 is observed as Blessed Anne Catherine Emmerich.
